map.砌筑/抹灰常用水泥砂浆有固定配合比。选择标号与总方量，自动换算水泥、砂、水的用量: Masonry/plaster cement mortar has fixed mix ratios. Pick grade and total volume to auto-convert cement, sand and water amounts (weight and bags) for easy purchase.
map.砌筑用 M5/M7.5/M10 砂浆，按强度选水泥砂比（如 1:3~1:5），估: For M5/M7.5/M10 masonry mortar, pick cement-sand ratio by strength (e.g. 1:3-1:5) to estimate per-m3 materials.
map.墙面抹灰按 1:2~1:3 估算，核对砂的含泥量与过筛要求，避免空鼓。: Plaster at 1:2-1:3; check sand mud content and sieving to avoid hollowing.
map.地面找平用较干硬砂浆，按厚度算每㎡用量再乘面积得总量。: Floor leveling uses a stiffer mix; compute per-m2 by thickness then multiply by area for total.
map.质量比 水泥:砂 ≈ 1:4.5\n每方约：水泥 280kg，砂 1500kg，:
Mass ratio cement:sand ~ 1:4.5
Per m3 about: cement 280kg, sand 1500kg, water ~300kg (by sand moisture)
map.承重砌体用 M5 以上，抹灰/找平用更低；具体以设计为准，标号过高易开裂且不经济: Load-bearing masonry uses M5+, plaster/leveling lower; follow design; too high a grade cracks and is uneconomic.
map.宜用中砂、含泥量达标并过筛；泥多会削弱粘结、易空鼓脱落。: Use medium sand with compliant mud content and sieved; excess mud weakens bond and causes hollowing.
map.能加胶水或砂浆王吗？: Can glue or mortar additive be added?
map.外加剂须按产品与规范添加，乱加会降强；本工具不含外加剂配比，需另查。: Admixtures must follow product and code; random use lowers strength; this tool excludes admixture ratios, check separately.
map.常用配合比：M5 水泥:砂=1:5.0、M7.5=1:4.8、M10=1:4.5: Common mixes: M5 cement:sand=1:5.0, M7.5=1:4.8, M10=1:4.5, M15=1:4.0
map.水泥用量为估算基准，实际按《砌筑砂浆配合比设计规程》试配: Cement amount is an estimate; actual mix follows the masonry mortar design code.
map.砂的含水率会显著影响实际加水量: Sand moisture strongly affects actual water addition.
map.结果仅供参考，工程用量请以设计图纸与试验配合比为准: For reference only; actual quantities follow design drawings and test mixes.
map.按用途给出水泥砂浆质量比与每方用量，辅助砌筑/抹灰/找平配料。: Gives cement mortar mass ratio and per-m3 quantity by use, aiding masonry/plaster/leveling batching.
